s.d: ἐγώ, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς, of person(s) pron. I. (a) The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in [[matthew 3 11|Mat.3:11]], [[mark 1 8|Mrk.1:8]], [[luke 3 16|Luk.3:16]], al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as [[matthew 10 16|Mat.10:16]], [[john 10 17|Jhn.10:17]]; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. הִנֵּנִי, cf. [[1-kings 3 8|1Ki.3:8]]), [[acts 9 10|Act.9:10]]; ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), I am, [[john 1 23|Jhn.1:23]] (LXX), [[acts 7 32|Act.7:32]] (LXX). (b) The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, [[john 14 20|Jhn.14:20;]] μου τ. λόγους, [[matthew 7 24|Mat.7:24;]] ὀπίσω μου, [[matthew 3 11|Mat.3:11;]] ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, [[revelation 5 5|Rev.5:5;]] also with the prep. πρός, as [[mark 9 19|Mrk.9:19]], al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι᾽ ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as [[luke 10 16|Luk.10:16]], [[john 7 23|Jhn.7:23]], [[mark 14 7|Mrk.14:7]], al. (with) The genitive μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, [[matthew 2 6|Mat.2:6;]] μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, [[mark 9 24|Mrk.9:24.]] (d) τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. מַה־לִי וָלָךְ, [[judges 11 12|Jdg.11:12]], al.), i.e. what have we in common: [[matthew 8 29|Mat.8:29]], [[mark 1 24|Mrk.1:24, 5:7]], [[luke 8 28|Luk.8:28]], [[john 2 4|Jhn.2:4]]; τί γάρ μοι, [[1-corinthians 5 2|1Co.5:2.]] (e) The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (see M, Pr., 86f., M, Th., 131f.). (f) κἀγώ (= καὶ ἐγώ), and I, even I, I also: [[matthew 2 8|Mat.2:8]], [[luke 2 48|Luk.2:48]], [[john 6 56|Jhn.6:56]], [[romans 3 7|Rom.3:7]], [[1-corinthians 7 40|1Co.7:40]], al.; κἀγώ . . . καί, both . . . and, [[john 7 28|Jhn.7:28.]] (AS)

ἐν, prep, (the most frequently of all in NT), with dative (= Heb. בְּ, Lat. in, with abl.). I. Of place, with dative of thing(s), of person(s), in, within, on, at, by, among: ἐν τ. πόλει, [[luke 7 37|Luk.7:37;]] τ. οφθαλμῷ, [[matthew 7 3|Mat.7:3;]] τ. κοιλίᾳ, [[matthew 12 40|Mat.12:40;]] τ. ὄρει, [[2-peter 1 18|2Pe.1:18;]] τ. θρόνῳ, [[revelation 3 21|Rev.3:21;]] τ. δεξιᾷ τ. θεοῦ, [[romans 8 34|Rom.8:34;]] ἐν ἡμῖν Abbott-Smith has ὑμῖν., [[luke 1 1|Luk.1:1;]] of books, ἐν τ. βιβλίῳ, [[galatians 3 10|Gal.3:10;]] τ. νόμῳ, [[matthew 12 5|Mat.12:5]], al.; ἐν τοῖς τ. Πατρός, in my Father's house (RV; cf. M, Pr., 103), [[luke 2 49|Luk.2:49;]] trop., of the region of thought or feeling, ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ (-αις), [[matthew 5 28|Mat.5:28]], [[2-corinthians 4 6|2Co.4:6]], al.; τ. συνειδήσεσιν, [[2-corinthians 5 11|2Co.5:11;]] after verbs of motion, instead of εἰς (constructio praegnans, a usage extended in late Gk. beyond the limits observed in cl.; cf. Bl., §41, 1; M, Th., 12), ἀποστέλλω . . . ἐν, [[matthew 10 16|Mat.10:16.]] δέδωκεν ἐν τ. χειρί (cf. τιθέναι ἐν χερσί, Hom., Il., i, 441, al.), [[john 3 35|Jhn.3:35;]] id. after verbs of coming and going (not in cl.), εἰσῆλθε, [[luke 9 46|Luk.9:46;]] ἐξῆλθεν, [[luke 7 17|Luk.7:17.]] II. Of state, condition, form, occupation, etc.: ἐν ζωῇ, [[romans 5 10|Rom.5:10;]] ἐν τ. θανάτῳ, [[1-john 3 14|1Jn.3:14;]] ἐν πειρασμοῖς, [[1-peter 1 6|1Pe.1:6;]] ἐν εἰρήνῃ, [[mark 5 25|Mrk.5:25;]] ἐν δόξῃ, [[philippians 4 19|Php.4:19;]] ἐν πραΰτητι, [[james 3 13|Jas.3:13;]] ἐν μυστηρίῳ, [[1-corinthians 2 7|1Co.2:7;]] ἐν τ. διδαχῇ, [[mark 4 2|Mrk.4:2;]] of a part as contained in a whole, ἐν τ. ἀμπέλῳ, [[john 15 4|Jhn.15:4;]] ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι, [[romans 12 4|Rom.12:4;]] of accompanying objects or persons (simple dative in cl.), with, ἐν αἵματι, [[hebrews 9 25|Heb.9:25;]] ἐν δέκα χιλιάσιν, [[luke 14 31|Luk.14:31]] (cf. Ju 14, [[acts 7 14|Act.7:14]]); similarly (cl.), of clothing, armour, arms, ἐν στολαῖς, [[mark 12 38|Mrk.12:38;]] ἐν ἐσθῆτι λαμπρᾷ, [[james 2 2|Jas.2:2;]] ἐν μαξαίρῃ, [[luke 22 49|Luk.22:49;]] ἐν ῥάβδῳ, [[1-corinthians 4 21|1Co.4:21]] (cf. ἐν τόξοις, Xen., Mem., 3, 9, 2); of manner (cl.), ἐν τάχει (= ταχέως), [[luke 18 8|Luk.18:8]] (cf. Bl., §41, 1); of spiritual influence, ἐν πνεύματι, [[romans 8 9|Rom.8:9;]] ἐν π. ἀκαθάρτῳ, [[mark 1 23|Mrk.1:23;]] of the mystical relation of the Christian life and the believer himself, to God and Christ (cf. ICC, Ro., 160f.; Mayor on Ju 1; M, Pr., 103): ἐν Χριστῷ, [[romans 3 24|Rom.3:24, 6:11]], [[1-corinthians 3 1|1Co.3:1, 4:10]], [[2-corinthians 12 2|2Co.12:2]], [[galatians 2 17|Gal.2:17]], [[ephesians 6 21|Eph.6:21]], [[colossians 4 7|Col.4:7]], [[1-thessalonians 4 16|1Th.4:16]], al. III. Of the agent, instrument or means (an extension of cl. ἐν of instr.—see LS, see word Ill—corresponding to similar use of Heb. בְּ), by, with: ἐν ὑμῖν κρίνεται ὁ κόσμος (= cl. παρά, C. dative), [[1-corinthians 6 2|1Co.6:2;]] ἐν τ. ἄρχοντι τ. δαιμονίων, [[matthew 9 34|Mat.9:34;]] ἐν αἵματι, [[hebrews 9 22|Heb.9:22;]] ἐν ὕδατι, [[matthew 3 11|Mat.3:11]], al.; ἐν μαχαίρᾳ ἀποκτενεῖ (cf. the absol. ἐν μ., ἐν ῥάβδῳ, supr., II, which some would classify here), [[revelation 13 10|Rev.13:10]] ([[revelation 6 8|cf. 6:8]]). Allied to this usage and distinctly Semitic are the following: ἠγόρασας . . . ἐν τ. αἵματι σου (cf. BDB, see word בְּ, III, 3), [[revelation 5 9|Rev.5:9;]] ὁμολογεῖν ἐν (= Aram. אודי בּ; cf. McNeile on Mt, I.with; M, Pr., 104), [[matthew 10 32|Mat.10:32]], [[luke 12 8|Luk.12:8]]; ὀμνύναι ἐν (= cl. accusative, so [[james 5 12|Jas.5:12]]), [[matthew 5 34|Mat.5:34]], al.; also at the rate of, amounting to, [[mark 4 8|Mrk.4:8]] (WH; vv. ll., εἰς, ἒν), [[acts 7 14|Act.7:14]] (LXX). IV. Of time, (a) in or during a period: ἐν τ. ἡμέρᾳ (νυκτί), [[john 11 9|Jhn.11:9]], al.; ἐν σαββάτῳ, [[matthew 12 2|Mat.12:2]], al.; ἐν τῷ μεταξύ, meanwhile, [[john 4 31|Jhn.4:31;]] (b) at the time of an event: ἐν τ. παρουσίᾳ, [[1-corinthians 15 23|1Co.15:23;]] ἐν τ. ἀναστάσει, [[matthew 22 28|Mat.22:28;]] (with) with art. inf., (α) present (so sometimes in cl., but not as in NT = ἕως; V. M, Pr., 215), while: [[matthew 13 4|Mat.13:4]], [[mark 6 48|Mrk.6:48]], [[galatians 4 18|Gal.4:18]], al.; (β) aor., when, after: [[luke 9 36|Luk.9:36]], al.; (d) within (cl.): [[matthew 27 40|Mat.27:40]], V. In composition: (1) meaning: (a) with adjectives, it signifies usually the possession of a quality, as ἐνάλιος, ἐν́δοξος; (b) with verbs, continuance in (before ἐν) or motion into (before εἰς), as ἐμμένω, ἐμβαίνω. (ii) Assimilation: ἐν becomes ἐμ- before β, μ, π, φ, ψ; ἐγ- before γ, κ, ξ, χ; ἐλ- before λ. But in the older MSS of NT, followed by modern editions, assimilation is sometimes neglected, as in ἐνγράφω, ἐγκαινίζω, etc. (AS)

ἐν-αντίος, -α, -ον (ἀντίος, set against), [in LXX: ἐξ ἐναντίας, for נֶגֶד, etc.; ἐναντίον, for פָּנִים etc. ;] over against, opposite, contrary: ἄνεμος, [[matthew 14 24|Mat.14:24]], [[mark 6 48|Mrk.6:48]], [[acts 27 4|Act.27:4]]; ἐξ ἐναντίας (ellipse obscure, see Bl., § 44,1; Mozley, [[psalms 42 1|Psa.42:1-11]]), with genitive, [[mark 15 39|Mrk.15:39.]] Metaphorical, opposed, hostile: [[1-thessalonians 2 15|1Th.2:15]], [[acts 26 9|Act.26:9 28:17]]; ὁ ἐξ ἐ., [[titus 2 8|Tit.2:8.]] Neuter., -ίον, adv., as prep. with genitive, before, in the presence of: [[luke 1 6|Luk.1:6 20:26 24:19]] [[acts 7 10|Act.7:10]] (ἔναντι, T), [[acts 8 32|Act.8:32]] (LXX).† (AS)
ἐν-άρχομαι [in LXX chiefly for חָלַל hi. ;] to begin, make a beginning: [[galatians 3 3|Gal.3:3]], [[philippians 1 6|Php.1:6]].† (AS)

ἕν-δεκα, οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl., eleven: of the eleven apostles, οἱ, ἕ., [[matthew 28 16|Mat.28:16]], [[mark 16 14|Mrk.16:14]], [[luke 24 9|Luk.24:9, 33]], [[acts 1 26|Act.1:26 2:14]].† (AS)

ἐνδιδύσκω [in LXX: [[2-kings 1 24|2Ki.1:24 13:18]], [[proverbs 31 21|Pro.31:21]] (לָבַשׁ), Jdth.9:1 10:3, Sir.50:11 * ;] to put on: with dupl. accusative, [[mark 15 17|Mrk.15:17]] (ἐνδύουσι, Rec.). ἔνδικος, -ον (δίκη), righteous, just: [[romans 3 8|Rom.3:8]], [[hebrews 2 2|Heb.2:2]] (Cremer, 204).† (AS)

ἐν-δοξάζω [in LXX for כָּבַד ni., [[exodus 14 4|Exo.14:4, 17-18]], [[ezekiel 28 22|Eze.28:22]], etc.; for עָרַץ, [[psalms 89 7|Psa.89:7;]] Sir.38:6, al. ;] to glorify: pass., [[2-thessalonians 1 10|2Th.1:10-12.]]† (AS)

ἔνδοξος, -ον (δόξα [in LXX for כָּבַד, etc. ;] 1. held in honour, of high repute: [[1-corinthians 4 10|1Co.4:10.]] 2. glorious, splendid: of deeds, τά ἔ., [[luke 13 17|Luk.13:17;]] of clothing, [[luke 7 25|Luk.7:25.]] Metaphorical, ἐκκλησία, [[ephesians 5 27|Eph.5:27]] (cf. παράδοξος).† (AS)
ἔνδυμα, -τος, τό (ἐνω), [in LXX chiefly for לְבוּשׁ ;] raiment, clothing, a garment: [[matthew 3 4|Mat.3:4 6:25, 28 7:15 22:11-12 28:3]], [[luke 12 23|Luk.12:23]].† (AS)

Pass., [[acts 9 22|Act.9:22;]] C. dative, [[romans 4 20|Rom.4:20;]] before ἐν, [[2-timothy 2 1|2Ti.2:1]] (ἐν Κυρίῳ), [[ephesians 6 10|Eph.6:10]] (Cremer, 221).† (AS)

ἐν-δύνω, see: ἐνδύω. ἐν-δύω (ἐνδύνω, [[2-timothy 3 6|2Ti.3:6]]), [in LXX chiefly for לָבַשׁ ;] 1. with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 27 28|Mat.27:28]] (WH, mg., R, mg.); with dupl. accusative, [[matthew 27 31|Mat.27:31]], [[mark 15 20|Mrk.15:20]], [[luke 15 22|Luk.15:22]]; mid., to put on oneself, be clothed with: with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 6 25|Mat.6:25]], [[mark 6 9|Mrk.6:9]], [[luke 8 27|Luk.8:27 12:22]], [[acts 12 21|Act.12:21]]; ptcp., [[matthew 22 11|Mat.22:11]], [[mark 1 6|Mrk.1:6]], [[2-corinthians 5 3|2Co.5:3]], [[revelation 1 13|Rev.1:13 15:6 19:14]]; of armour (figuratively): [[romans 13 12|Rom.13:12]], [[ephesians 6 11|Eph.6:11, 14]], [[1-thessalonians 5 8|1Th.5:8]]; metaphorically, δύναμιν, [[luke 24 49|Luk.24:49;]] ἀφθαρσίαν, ἀθανασίαν, [[1-corinthians 15 53|1Co.15:53-54;]] τ. καινὸν ἄνθρωπον, [[ephesians 4 24|Eph 4:24]], [[colossians 3 10|Col.3:10]]; σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, [[colossians 3 12|Col.3:12;]] Ἰησ. Χριστόν, [[romans 13 14|Rom.13:14]], [[galatians 3 27|Gal.3:27]], 2. to enter, press into: [[2-timothy 3 6|2Ti.3:6]] (cf. ἐπ-ενδύω).† (AS)
ἔν-δυσις, -εως, ἡ (ἐνδύω), [in LXX: [[job 41 13|Job.41:13]] (לְבוּשׁ), [[esther 5 1|Est.5:1]] * ;] a putting on: ίματίων, [[1-peter 3 3|1Pe.3:3.]]† (AS)

ἐνεδρεύω (ἐνέδρα), [in LXX chiefly for אָרַב ;] to lie in wait for: with accusative of person(s), [[luke 11 54|Luk.11:54]], [[acts 23 21|Act.23:21]].† (AS)

ἐν-ειλέω, -ῶ [in LXX [[1-samuel 21 9|1Ki.21:9]] לוּט * ;] to roll in, wind in: with accusative of person(s) and dative of thing(s), [[mark 15 46|Mrk.15:46.]]† (AS)
ἔν-ειμι 1. to be in, within ([[job 27 3|Job.27:3]], al.): ptcp. pl., τὰ ἐνόντα, [[luke 11 41|Luk.11:41]] (R, txt., cf. MM, Exp., xii). 2. to be possible: [[luke 11 41|Luk.11:41]] (R, mg.).† (AS)

ἕνεκα (so [[matthew 19 5|Mat.19:5]], [[luke 6 22|Luk.6:22]], [[acts 19 32|Act.19:32 26:21]]; elsewhere, prop, only before a vowel, ἕνεκεν; εἵνεκεν, originally Ionic: [[luke 4 18|Luk.4:18 18:29]], [[acts 28 20|Act.28:20]], [[2-corinthians 3 10|2Co.3:10]]), prep. with genitive, on account of, because of: [[matthew 5 10|Mat.5:10-11 16:25 19:29]], [[mark 8 35|Mrk.8:35]], [[luke 6 22|Luk.6:22]], [[acts 28 20|Act.28:20]], [[romans 8 36|Rom.8:36]], [[2-corinthians 3 10|2Co.3:10]]; ἕ. τούτου, [[matthew 19 5|Mat.19:5;]] υούτων, [[acts 26 21|Act.26:21;]] τίνος ἕ., [[acts 19 32|Act.19:32;]] before τοῦ, with inf., [[2-corinthians 7 12|2Co.7:12;]] οὗ ἕν., [[luke 4 18|Luk.4:18]] (AS)

ἐνέργεια, -ας, ἡ (ἐνεργής), [in LXX: Wis.7:17, 26 13:4 18:22, 2Ma.3:29, 3Ma.4:21 3Mac 5:12 3Mac 5:28 * ;] operative power (as distinct from δύναμις, potential power), working: of God, [[ephesians 1 19|Eph.1:19 3:7 4:16]], [[philippians 3 21|Php.3:21]], [[colossians 1 29|Col.1:29 2:12]]; of Satan, [[2-thessalonians 2 9|2Th.2:9 2:11]] (cf. M, Th., l.with; AR, Eph., 241 ff.; Cremer, 261).† (AS)

ἐνεργέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[numbers 8 24|Num.8:24]] B (עֲבֹדָה צָבָא), [[isaiah 41 4|Isa.41:4]], [[proverbs 21 6|Pro.21:6]] (פָּעַל), [[proverbs 31 12|Pro.31:12]] (גָּמַל), I [[esther 2 20|Est.2:20]], Wis.15:11 16:17 * ;] (for full lexical treatment, see AR, Eph., 243 ff.); 1. intrans., to be at work or in action, to operate (opposite to ἀργέω): before ἐν, with dative of person(s), [[matthew 14 2|Mat.14:2]], [[mark 6 14|Mrk.6:14]], [[ephesians 2 2|Eph.2:2]]; with dative of person(s), before εἰς (Lft., in l), [[galatians 2 8|Gal.2:8.]] 2. Trans., to work, effect, do: with accusative of thing(s), [[1-corinthians 12 11|1Co.12:11]], [[ephesians 1 11|Eph.1:11]]; id, before ἐν, with dative of person(s), [[1-corinthians 12 6|1Co.12:6]], [[galatians 3 5|Gal.3:5]], [[philippians 2 13|Php.2:13]]; ἐ. ἐνέργειαν, [[ephesians 1 19|Eph.1:19-20]] Pass. (taken as mid. by Lft., Ga., 204 f.; but see AR, Eph., l.with; Milligan, Th., 28 f.; Mayor, Ja., 177 ff.), in NT, "always used of some principle or power at work" (Meyer), to be actuated, set in operation: [[2-thessalonians 2 7|2Th.2:7;]] before ἐν, [[romans 7 5|Rom.7:5]], [[2-corinthians 1 6|2Co.1:6 4:12]], [[ephesians 3 20|Eph.3:20]], [[colossians 1 29|Col.1:29]], [[1-thessalonians 2 13|1Th.2:13]]; before διά, with genitive of thing(s), [[galatians 5 6|Gal.5:6;]] ἐνεργουμένη (M, Pr., 156), [[james 5 16|Jas.5:16]] (Cremer, 262).† (AS)
ἐνέργημα, -τος, τό (ἐνεργέω), effect, operation (Polyb.): pl., [[1-corinthians 12 6|1Co.12:6 12:10]] (Cremer, 262, 713).† (AS)
ἐνεργής, -ές (late form of ἐνεργός, on WH. cf. AR, Eph., 241), at work, active, effective: [[1-corinthians 16 9|1Co.16:9]], Phm 6, [[hebrews 4 12|Heb.4:12]] (Cremer, 261).† (AS)
ἐν-ευλογέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for בָּרַךְ ;] to bless: pass., before ἐν, [[acts 3 25|Act.3:25]] (LXX), [[galatians 3 8|Gal.3:8]] (LXX) (Cremer, 770).† (AS)

MM, Exp., xii); θλίψρεσιν, [[2-thessalonians 1 4|2Th.1:4]] (cf. ἀσεβείσιν, 3Mac, l.with). 2. to set oneself against, be urgent against (as Ge, l.with; for con­struction, see Swete, Mk., l.with): [[mark 6 19|Mrk.6:19]], [[luke 11 53|Luk.11:53]].† (AS)
ἐνθυμέομαι, -οῦμαι (θυμός), [in LXX for דָּמָה pi., etc. ;] to reflect on, ponder: with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 1 20|Mat.1:20 9:4]].† (AS)

ἐνθύμησις, -εως, ἡ (ἐνθυμέομαι), [in Sm.: [[job 21 27|Job.21:27]], [[ezekiel 11 21|Eze.11:21]] * ;] consideration, pondering (EV, device): [[acts 17 29|Act.17:29;]] pl., thoughts, feel­ings: [[matthew 9 4|Mat.9:4 12:25]], [[hebrews 4 12|Heb.4:12]].† SYN.: ἔννοια, the action of the reason; while ἐνθ. is rather that of the affections (cf. Westc., Heb., l.with) (AS)

ἐννενήκοντα, see: ἐνεν-. ἐνενήκοντα (Rec. ἐννεν-), οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl., ninety: [[matthew 18 12|Mat.18:12-13]], [[luke 15 4|Luk.15:4]], 7.† (AS)
ἐνεός (Rec. ἐνν-), -οῦ, ὁ [in LXX: [[isaiah 56 10|Isa.56:10]] (אִלֵּם), Ep. [[jeremiah 41 1|Jer.41:1-18;]] ἐ. ποιεῖν, [[proverbs 17 28|Pro.17:28]] * ;] dumb, speechless: [[acts 9 7|Act.9:7.]]† (AS)

ἑνότης, -ητος, ἡ (εἷς), unity, unanimity: [[ephesians 4 3|Eph.4:3, 13]].† (AS)
